reading: SAP SE is a publicly traded German enterprise software company headquartered in Walldorf, Germany, primarily listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange and also listed on the NYSE, both under ticker SAP, filing with the SEC as a foreign private issuer on Form 20-F. SAP's Colorado facility, branded SAP COS02, sits in El Paso County on the T5 at Colorado campus operated by T5 Data Centers, another operator already profiled elsewhere in this registry, with trade press reporting SAP as the first tenant to sign on to that campus. The facility supports SAP's cloud services infrastructure, which delivers the company's enterprise resource planning and other hosted business applications to customers worldwide, a business model that has grown to represent an increasing share of SAP's overall revenue as the company shifts customers from on-premises software licenses toward cloud subscriptions. Because SAP leases its Colorado capacity from T5 rather than owning the underlying building, this facility illustrates a common pattern in this registry where a large enterprise software or cloud company operates as a major tenant within a wholesale developer's campus, sitting conceptually between a fully enterprise-captive facility and a pure third-party colocation relationship, and this registry records it under SAP as the operating tenant while cross-referencing T5 as the underlying landlord.
